risks.name: Critical dependency vulnerabilities
risks.treatment: Run weekly security audits, update packages, validate lock files, and confirm no critical vulnerabilities remain before release.

risks.name: Container image vulnerabilities
risks.treatment: Scan base images regularly, patch OS packages, and rebuild the image with the latest secure base layers.

risks.name: Web application exposure to common OWASP attacks
risks.treatment: Keep security tests in CI, review ZAP findings, harden headers, validate input handling, and monitor production logs.
